# Kodi brand art (provenance, not synced into the skin)

Original: `Thumbnail-symbol-transparent.png` (the Kodi "K" symbol in brand, blue on transparent, 625x625 palette PNG).

Source: https://kodi.wiki/view/Official:Media_center_logos
Direct file: https://kodi.wiki/images/8/8e/Thumbnail-symbol-transparent.png

(c) XBMC Foundation, used per the Kodi trademark policy. Kept here so the white silhouette in `media/header/kodi-symbol.png` stays reproducible: it is the original alpha carried over onto white, which lets the skin tint it gray/accent via `colordiffuse` like every other row icon.
